classes.label: Common stock (issued shares less treasury shares)

computedFrom.label: Shares issued (including treasury shares) at September 30, 2026

source.label: Consolidated Results for the Six Months Ended September 30, 2026 (Consolidated Financial Highlights, November 5, 2026), (4) Outstanding shares
source.quote: 1) Number of shares outstanding (including treasury shares) As of Sep. 30, 2026: 1,287,260,000 shares

source.label: Consolidated Results for the Six Months Ended September 30, 2026 (Consolidated Financial Highlights, November 5, 2026), (4) Outstanding shares
source.quote: 2) Number of treasury shares As of Sep. 30, 2026: 134,341,050 shares

notes: One class of common stock, priced from its primary listing on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (7974.T) rather than the U.S. OTC ADRs (NTDOY). Shares = 1,287,260,000 issued − 134,341,050 treasury = 1,152,918,950 at September 30, 2026, from Nintendo's half-year results released November 5, 2026; the release states both parts but not the difference. The issued count fell from 1,298,690,000 because Nintendo cancelled 11,430,000 treasury shares on March 31, 2026.
